caption: The drawing features a single object rendered in grayscale pencil or charcoal on an off-white background. The object appears to be a metallic tool or abstract form consisting of a long, straight horizontal shaft with several protruding elements: on the left side, a U-shaped bend curves downward and then back up through a rectangular slot in the main shaft; in the center, a short upright peg sticks upward; on the right end, there is a large, curved and vertically oriented flange or blade, attached at an angle to the shaft and featuring a smooth, broad surface. The shading is smooth and consistent, giving the object a three-dimensional, solid appearance. The composition places the object diagonally across the page, with the upper right section of the drawing containing the widened blade-like end, and the lower left containing the U-shaped bend. The background is plain and unshaded, emphasizing the form of the object.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
